digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify and External Integration Tests
propositions: Complete live Pandoc corpus replay on every Gerrit Verify cell contributes 184.32-second macOS lower bound and must be moved out of the per-change hot path while retaining all behavioral assertions and complete real-Pandoc replay capability.

Static committed Pandoc outputs must replace deterministic live subprocess invocations for 178 corpus bodies across 1,383 ordered conversions, with one representative live body per stratum (code_arrow/table/prose) retained for evidence and provenance validation.

A new external pandoc-corpus-replay job must run complete corpus replay through real Pandoc on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix arms from weekly schedule and workflow_dispatch, decoupled from per-change Verify.

Fixture generation, validation, version/platform fingerprint probes, and fail-closed static lookup must preserve Pandoc 3.6.1 contract plus Linux x86_64 and Darwin arm64 binary SHA-256 identity without introducing new dependencies or weakened assertions.
